summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-anvil2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package advertises itself as a React chatbot UI but declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs", which downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it via execFileSync to run math_init.js (a ~727KB obfuscated JS bundle sitting at the package root). If a system `bun` is already installed it is used directly. setup.mjs itself has hex-mangled identifiers (_0x...) that hide the intent of the loader. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (rotated string-array via a WV8StW-style shuffler, hex-mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) and is not referenced by the package's declared React source under src/ or dist/index.js — it exists solely to be run by the preinstall dropper. Fetching a second JS runtime purely to execute an opaque bundled payload at install time, in a package whose stated purpose is a chatbot UI, executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
